method: German tank problem -- estimate a total population from a sample of serial numbers (the true maximum sits about one average inter-sample gap beyond the largest observed serial).

confirmed_serials.note: consecutive with 024992 (1 apart); acquired as a pair from one lot (2026-08)
consecutive with 024991; same lot -- confirms multi-unit lots were numbered consecutively

estimate.detail: avg gap = (25327-2659)/(10-1) = 2518.7; estimate ~ 25327 + 2519 = 27846; MVUE = 25327*(k+1)/k - 1 = 27859; standard error ~ N/k ~ 2800. The 024991/024992 consecutive pair confirms multi-unit lots were numbered consecutively; both new serials landed in the high cluster, so the 13,626->22,662 mid-range gap stayed empty as k grew (a mild nudge toward a real gap, still far from conclusive).

context: Serials count units MANUFACTURED, not shipped. The FTC found Butterfly Labs built machines and largely did not deliver them (allegedly self-mined; ~$50M in orders; $38.6M settlement, 2016). BFL's disputed public claim was 50,000+ machines across five product generations; the FTC found no documentation for it.
